findings.observed: The targeted-ROI stem names viable enhancing solid tissue and nonenhancing necrosis. Alternatives deliberately placing the ROI partly outside the lesion in normal fat or in an acknowledged adjacent artifact zone remain implausible, leaving a conspicuously qualified correct answer. The key and EUSOBI explanation are sound.
findings.impact: The new item can be answered by basic avoidance of obviously invalid measurement rather than selecting among plausible lesion-sampling choices.
